thesis: Kratos is positioned across autonomous mass, propulsion/hypersonics and resilient communications where defense demand is durable, with upside dependent on converting awards and capacity into profitable serial production.
keyRisk: Scaling investment and opaque program economics fail to convert strong demand into durable cash returns.
nextCatalyst: Conversion of recent awards and raised 2026 outlook into reported revenue, margins and funded backlog progression.
